text.ja: 浅角度分散波束の長時間・同格子孤立境界参照 \widehat U^n(k_x)=M(k_x,\Delta t)^n\widehat U^0(k_x),\quad K_y=2\sin(k_y\Delta y/2)/\Delta y 均質Lorentz媒質はPML内まで連続し、ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12、γ=0または0.005。Ez偏光の有限kx Gaussianはcarrierω=6、中心位相角80度。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時細分化し、垂直対照は6、弱減衰細格子対照は12。最終時刻は700です。
text.en: Isolated same-grid reference for a long grazing dispersive packet \widehat U^n(k_x)=M(k_x,\Delta t)^n\widehat U^0(k_x),\quad K_y=2\sin(k_y\Delta y/2)/\Delta y The homogeneous Lorentz medium continues through the PML: epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2, omega_0 = 12, gamma = 0 or 0.005. An Ez-polarized finite-kx Gaussian has carrier omega = 6 and central phase angle 80 degrees. Joint grid/layer refinement uses peaks 6/9/12 on 512/768/1024 cells; the normal control uses 6 and damped fine companion 12. Final time is 700.
